risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and well quantified, but includes standard forward-looking disclaimers and estimation caveats. Risk tone is mildly negative due to weaker frozen-food demand, declining gross margins, higher commodity and overhead costs, and a waived capital-expenditure covenant. Liquidity appears adequate, with no outstanding borrowings, although the new facility creates approximately $14.6 million of future obligations.
